tools.name: initialize_research_state
tools.rationale: Safe bootstrap capability for a new MCP workspace. It creates only missing research state, preserves existing state, and keeps orders_enabled=false.
tools.follow_up: Keep public. Clarify that it is idempotent bootstrap, not reset.

tools.name: get_workspace_status
tools.rationale: Overlaps get_system_status/get_dashboard_status for general status, but still uniquely exposes initialization, selected mode, audit record count, and manifest count.
tools.follow_up: In 3-6.2 decide whether to keep as lightweight bootstrap status or fold its unique fields into one canonical status response.

tools.name: set_research_mode
tools.rationale: The public MCP is paper-research only. Selecting live never enables orders and actively makes SystemController paper preflight fail, so exposing this state toggle to an agent is operationally confusing.
tools.follow_up: Prefer host/CLI-controlled mode selection; remove from public MCP only after a compatibility/deprecation step.

tools.name: validate_research_cache
tools.rationale: This is a maintenance/integrity helper that only counts valid manifests. It is not part of the primary research lifecycle and does not actually rebuild a cache.
tools.follow_up: Keep the service/CLI maintenance path; consider removing it from the default public MCP surface.

tools.name: validate_strategy
tools.rationale: A safe static validation boundary before evaluation or import. It does not execute external source and is directly useful to an MCP agent.

tools.name: import_strategies
tools.rationale: The canonical safe strategy intake path. It defaults to dry-run, uses static analysis, constrains project paths/repository URLs, and never executes imported code.
tools.follow_up: Keep public; preserve dry_run=true default and path/repository safety tests.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.rationale: Distinct read-only catalog discovery capability. It avoids making the agent infer imported strategies from filesystem state.

tools.name: plan_generation
tools.rationale: Pure deterministic planning primitive, but it has no production caller outside MCP/tests and the canonical autoresearch loop performs its own experiment planning.
tools.follow_up: Retain as an internal/application primitive; consider hiding it from the default public tool list.

tools.name: get_research_context
tools.rationale: It is a synthesized LLM prompt-context projection combining champion, observations, failure knowledge, and the feature catalog. The canonical managed research loop constructs/uses its own context, and this method has no production caller except MCP.
tools.follow_up: Keep the context builder internally for diagnostics/tests; prefer domain-specific public reads rather than one large prompt-oriented payload.

tools.name: list_features
tools.rationale: Distinct capability discovery for valid feature candidates. It is smaller and more explicit than get_research_context.

tools.name: get_research_evidence
tools.rationale: Authoritative attributable research-evidence interface with explicit integrity-error handling and sealed-OOS safety semantics.

tools.name: get_dashboard_status
tools.rationale: Provides typed performance/account/trend/strategy dashboard data that is intentionally different from process/runtime health in get_system_status.
tools.follow_up: Keep public, but document the distinction: dashboard=data/performance plane, system status=runtime/control plane.

tools.name: submit_research_intent
tools.rationale: The tool validates an intent and appends it to state/llm/intents.jsonl, but no production runtime consumes externally submitted journal entries. The journal is audit/supporting data, while start_system runs the canonical LLM->evaluation loop directly.
tools.follow_up: Highest-priority deprecation candidate. Do not remove until compatibility guidance is added; direct callers should use start_system or run_evaluation depending on intent.

tools.name: run_evaluation
tools.rationale: Useful bounded one-shot evaluation path over approved project inputs. It shares the canonical queued evaluator and is distinct from the multi-generation managed system.
tools.follow_up: Keep public as an advanced one-shot execution primitive; describe when to use it instead of start_system.

tools.name: check_system
tools.rationale: Side-effect-free preflight is valuable before a potentially expensive managed start, even though start_system also performs preflight.
tools.follow_up: Keep public; pair its documentation directly with start_system.

tools.name: start_system
tools.rationale: Canonical managed entry point for dashboard plus bounded autoresearch with the configured evaluation backend. It supersedes the old split intent/backtest workflow.
tools.follow_up: Keep as the primary research execution tool.

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.rationale: Primary operational runtime/control-plane view. It returns the typed RuntimeSnapshot and may intentionally reconcile an active managed lifecycle.
tools.follow_up: Keep as the canonical runtime status tool.

tools.name: stop_system
tools.rationale: Necessary paired lifecycle control for start_system, scoped to owned managed processes and evaluation jobs.
